title: Three Mornings and One Short Blanket
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：lap　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lap 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the nurse ① settled the lap that no patient in the ward would have recorded, and he said the settling was the whole of the morning. The ② lap, meaning the knee itself and not the blanket, ran three mornings and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lap, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lap in that ward had the same short blanket beside it, and the ④ lap at the far chair, meaning the book they kept for the children to hold and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lap, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the nurse said the recording is the part that fills three mornings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lap was the whole of the matter, meaning the rest and not the knee. The ⑥ lap, meaning the rest and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lap, he said, is either something you settle or the only word that means both a knee and a rest. He said the rest is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ lap had become a line in a chart, and the chart had become an argument about the short blanket. The ⑧ lap of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in January, was one ward and three mornings of recording; lap, he said, is either the book at the far chair or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lap I remember is the knee recorded in the chart, which closed in 1986 and is still recorded as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ lap, my mother said in 1988, is the only knee that improves by being recorded; every lap, she said, is a rest that has agreed to look like a knee. She said the rest was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 膝上；大腿部（指病房里每一处旁边的那一处）
B. n. 膝上；大腿部（指那处膝头本身，与毯子相对）
C. 固定搭配：settle the lap 把病人安放在膝上
D. n. 膝上；大腿部（指留给孩子们捧着的那本书那一处）
E. n. 照护之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的膝上之事）
F. n. 膝上；大腿部（指护理记录里写到、被记载的的那一处）
G. n. 歇处、依靠（指一件事里人人都抱却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 依靠（抽象总称，指人人都抱却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: settled the lap that no patient in the ward would have recorded
The lap, meaning the knee itself and not the blanket
the lap at the far chair
the lap was the whole of the matter
the lap had become a line in a chart
The lap of the whole thing
A lap, my mother said in 1988

answers.why: settle the lap 意为“把病人安放在膝上”，1979 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病人肯记载的一处膝上做了一遍。
lap 意为“膝上；大腿部”，指那处膝头本身而不是毯子，它经过了三个早晨而在簿子上没有被记载。
lap 意为“膝上；大腿部”，指病房里每一处旁边的那一处，每一处旁边都有同一条薄薄的毯子。
lap 意为“膝上；大腿部”，指最远那把椅边留给孩子们捧着的那本书那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lap 意为“歇处、依靠”，指一件事里人人都抱却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个依靠就是那件事的全部。
lap 意为“依靠”，指人人都抱却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处膝头，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lap 意为“膝上；大腿部”，指护理记录里写到、被记载的的那一处，到 1984 年这一处成了护理记录里的一行。
lap 意为“照护之事”，护士一月写道，整件事的膝上之事是一处病房和三个早晨的记载。
lap 意为“膝上；大腿部”，我记得的是护理记录里记载过的那一处，1986 年安顿了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一处。
lap 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，膝上是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的膝头。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年那位护士安放了病房里没有一位病人肯记载的一处膝上，他说这一遍才是那个早晨的全部。（settle the lap）
那处膝上，指的是那处膝头本身而不是毯子，经过了三个早晨而在簿子上没有被记载。（lap）
那处病房里每一处膝上旁边都有同一条薄薄的毯子。（lap）
最远那把椅边那处膝上，指的是他们留给孩子们捧着的那本书那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（lap）
叔叔说这个依靠就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那处膝头。（lap）
1988 年母亲说，膝上是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的膝头。（lap）
answers: In 1979 the nurse settled the lap that no patient in the ward would have recorded, and he said the settling was the whole of the morning.
The lap, meaning the knee itself and not the blanket, ran three mornings and stayed unrecorded in the book.
Every lap in that ward had the same short blanket beside it.
The lap at the far chair, meaning the book they kept for the children to hold and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the lap was the whole of the matter, meaning the rest and not the knee.
A lap, my mother said in 1988, is the only knee that improves by being recorded.
